new_email.description: The address the verification code is sent to. Committed verbatim as the user's email and, under an EMAIL identity policy, as preferred_username, so its shape is bounded here before any mail is sent. The pattern is the pragmatic local@domain.tld check, not full RFC 5322 - deliverability is proven by the code round-trip. 'format': 'email' is not used because JsonPropertyFormat has no EMAIL entry, so it would silently pass everything.
